Name: Better MrQi
Author: rachelkel04
Description:
After Wizard and Marlon, I realized our mysterious, observant, and blue friend needed a makeover! :D

It always bothered me that in the portraits, his clothes had colored polka dots, but not in the sprites :( so I fixed that.

In the portraits, I changed his hair, clothes (there are colored and white options for the polka dots), hat, and gave him a pet snake! (there are options with and without the snake) and slightly altered his face.

In the sprite, I added the polka dots to the clothes, modified the hair, and also added his pet snake (again, there are options to change the color of the polka dots and to add or not the snake).

You can change the style options through GMCM.

I believe it's compatible with Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic; just disable the "Mr Qi" option in the mod settings and everything will probably work fine.

[list]
[*]Download the mod files and extract them to the Stardew Valley mods folder. (The path should be something like: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)
[*]Run the game normally.
[/list]I hope you enjoy it! Feel free to comment if you have any feedback or if something isn't working. Thank you!
(This is also the first time I've tried posting a real mod, and not just image files. I hope it works well :)
